title: Member Protections Table — Medical Certificates by Rate Schedule (Electric Service by Rate Schedule)
content:
Whether a medical certificate can delay disconnection depends on the schedule of the Electric Service by Rate Schedule account. The table sets out the schedules on which a certificate is available, how long an accepted certificate delays disconnection, and how many certificates are accepted per service account in a rolling 12 months.

| Term | R | RS | FH | GS-1 | GS-3 | IR | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medical certificate can delay disconnection | Yes | No | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Calendar days an accepted certificate delays disconnection, from the received date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Certificates accepted per service account in a rolling 12 months | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |

Column key: R is Schedule R Residential Service; RS is Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service; FH is Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; GS-1 is Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; GS-3 is Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service; IR is Schedule IR Irrigation Service; LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

### Points of reading

- Only Schedule R Residential Service and Schedule FH Farm and Home Service accept a medical certificate. On the other five schedules the delay and renewal figures are listed but have no application.
- Where available, a certificate delays disconnection 30 calendar days from the date it is received, and up to 2 certificates are accepted per service account in a rolling 12 months.

### Hypothetical check

| Account (hypothetical) | Certificate available |
|---|---|
| Schedule R home | Yes, 30 calendar days |
| Schedule FH farm home | Yes, 30 calendar days |
| Schedule RS lake cabin | No |
| Schedule GS-1 shop | No |
